title: Low-Cal Haloumi Shakshuka
subtitle: with Crunchy Dippers
description: Instead of eggs, we've grilled haloumi in our version of this classic Middle Eastern dish. With golden cheese nestled in a rich tomato sauce, plus crunchy bread for dipping, it's a hearty low-cal option.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the grill to high. Thinly slice the onion. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Cut the haloumi into 5mm-thick slices. Cut the rolls in half.

Soften onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep ovenproof frypan (see Kitchen hack) over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the Moroccan seasoning and 1 tbs tomato paste and cook, stirring for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer shakshuka: Add the tomatoes and 125ml (½ cup) water to the onion mixture and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until thickened. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Remove the pan from the heat.

Grill bread dippers: Meanwhile, combine the garlic and 2 tsp olive oil in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Brush the garlic oil over the cut sides of the rolls and put on an oven tray. Grill for 3-4 mins until toasted.
Serve up: Arrange the haloumi on top of the shakshuka and grill for 5-7 mins until the haloumi is golden. Divide the shakshuka among bowls and serve with the bread dippers. Enjoy!

Kitchen hack: Your frypan will need an ovenproof handle to cook under the grill. If you don't have one, wrap the handle of a regular frypan with a double layer of foil, or transfer the tomato mixture to an ovenproof dish before topping with haloumi and grilling.
